context: A police officer briefs about an investigation
purpose: Teach: 問いかけ/たどっ/潰れ/壊さ/敷い/歪ん/聞き取れ/消さ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、住民への問いかけ、続けています。
lines.en: We're continuing to interview residents about this case.
lines.style: Professional, methodical. Even cadence. Opens clearly on the facts. No rush—the work will take what it takes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者をたどった捜査、地道ですね。
lines.en: Tracking the suspect through the investigation is slow work, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely interested. Soft onset. Slight uplift at the end—not a question, but an opening for confirmation. Respectful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。証拠が潰れた事案、再構築、慎重に。
lines.en: Yes. When evidence has been compromised, we have to rebuild very carefully.
lines.style: Steady, authoritative without being dismissive. Lands lightly on 'carefully'—that's where the weight matters. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現場の遺留品、壊さずに保全しますね。
lines.en: The physical evidence at the scene—you preserve it without damage, right.
lines.style: Gentle probe, testing understanding. Quiet certainty underneath. No doubt in his voice, just confirming the practice. Respectful listening.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。立ち入り禁止のテープ、敷いた直後に、報道入りました。
lines.en: Yes. We'd only just put up the barrier tape when the press showed up.
lines.style: Slight weariness—not frustration, just acknowledging pressure. Even tone. The facts delivered plainly. A hint of rueful acceptance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 証言、歪んだ内容、見抜く目、警察の力量ですね。
lines.en: Spotting distortions in witness testimony—that takes real police experience.
lines.style: Earnest, admiring. Slower pace on 'spotting distortions'—he's recognizing a skill. Warm without being obsequious. Genuine respect for the craft.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。雑音で聞き取れない部分、機材で補強します。
lines.en: Yes. We use equipment to fill in the parts obscured by background noise.
lines.style: Technical, but not cold. Clear explanation of method. Slight emphasis on 'fill in'—practical solution, not perfection. Professional confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 記録、消さずに保存、ですね。
lines.style: Quiet, final statement. Soft landing. This is the bedrock. Small vocal weight on 'preserved.' Acceptance. Almost meditative closure.
